<h2 id="tocS_PersonalAccessToken">PersonalAccessToken</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapersonalaccesstoken"></a>
<a id="schema_PersonalAccessToken"></a>
<a id="tocSpersonalaccesstoken"></a>
<a id="tocspersonalaccesstoken"></a>

```json
{
  "created": "2018-01-01T00:01:01",
  "expiry": "2018-01-01T13:46:32",
  "id": 123,
  "label": "linode-cli",
  "scopes": "*",
  "token": "abcdefghijklmnop"
}
```

A Personal Access Token is a token generated manually to access the API without going through an OAuth login.  Personal Access Tokens can have scopes just like OAuth tokens do, and are commonly used to give access to command-line tools like the Linode CLI, or when writing your own integrations.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|created|string(date-time)|false|read-only|The date and time this token was created.<br>|
|expiry|string(date-time)|false|read-only|When this token will expire.  Personal Access Tokens cannot be renewed, so after this time the token will be completely unusable and a new token will need to be generated.  Tokens may be created with "null" as their expiry and will never expire unless revoked.<br>|
|id|integer|false|read-only|This token's unique ID, which can be used to revoke it.<br>|
|label|string|false|none|This token's label.  This is for display purposes only, but can be used to more easily track what you're using each token for.<br>|
|scopes|string(oauth-scopes)|false|read-only|The scopes this token was created with. These define what parts of the Account the token can be used to access. Many command-line tools, such as the <a target="_top" href="https://github.com/linode/linode-cli">Linode CLI</a>, require tokens with access to `*`. Tokens with more restrictive scopes are generally more secure.<br>|
|token|string|false|read-only|The token used to access the API.  When the token is created, the full token is returned here.  Otherwise, only the first 16 characters are returned.<br>|

<h2 id="tocS_Profile">Profile</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaprofile"></a>
<a id="schema_Profile"></a>
<a id="tocSprofile"></a>
<a id="tocsprofile"></a>

```json
{
  "authentication_type": "password",
  "authorized_keys": null,
  "email": "example-user@gmail.com",
  "email_notifications": true,
  "ip_whitelist_enabled": false,
  "lish_auth_method": "keys_only",
  "referrals": {
    "code": "871be32f49c1411b14f29f618aaf0c14637fb8d3",
    "completed": 0,
    "credit": 0,
    "pending": 0,
    "total": 0,
    "url": "https://www.linode.com/?r=871be32f49c1411b14f29f618aaf0c14637fb8d3"
  },
  "restricted": false,
  "timezone": "US/Eastern",
  "two_factor_auth": true,
  "uid": 1234,
  "username": "exampleUser",
  "verified_phone_number": "+5555555555"
}
```

A Profile represents your User in our system. This is where you can change information about your User. This information is available to any OAuth Client regardless of requested scopes, and can be used to populate User information in third-party applications.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|authentication_type|string|false|read-only|This account's Cloud Manager authentication type. Authentication types are chosen through<br>Cloud Manager and authorized when logging into your account. These authentication types are either<br>the user's password (in conjunction with their username), or the name of their<br>indentity provider such as GitHub. For example, if a user:<br><br>- Has never used Third-Party Authentication, their authentication type will be `password`.<br>- Is using Third-Party Authentication, their authentication type will be the name of their Identity Provider (eg. `github`).<br>- Has used Third-Party Authentication and has since revoked it, their authentication type will be `password`.<br><br><br>**Note:** This functionality may not yet be available in Cloud Manager.<br>See the [Cloud Manager Changelog](/changelog/cloud-manager/) for the latest updates.<br>|
|authorized_keys|[string(ssh-key)]|false|none|The list of SSH Keys authorized to use Lish for your User. This value is ignored if `lish_auth_method` is "disabled."<br>|
|email|string(email)|false|none|Your email address.  This address will be used for communication with Linode as necessary.<br>|
|email_notifications|boolean|false|none|If true, you will receive email notifications about account activity.  If false, you may still receive business-critical communications through email.<br>|
|ip_whitelist_enabled|boolean|false|none|**Deprecated.** If true, logins for your User will only be allowed from whitelisted IPs. This setting is currently deprecated, and cannot be enabled.<br><br>If you disable this setting, you will not be able to re-enable it.<br>|
|lish_auth_method|string|false|none|The authentication methods that are allowed when connecting to [the Linode Shell (Lish)](/docs/guides/lish/).<br>* `keys_only` is the most secure if you intend to use Lish.<br>* `disabled` is recommended if you do not intend to use Lish at all.<br>* If this account's Cloud Manager authentication type is set to a Third-Party Authentication method, `password_keys` cannot be used as your Lish authentication method. To view this account's Cloud Manager `authentication_type` field, send a request to the [View Profile](/docs/api/profile/#profile-view) endpoint.<br>|
|referrals|object|false|read-only|Information about your status in our referral program.<br><br>This information becomes accessible after this Profile's Account has established at least $25.00 USD of total payments.<br>|
|restricted|boolean|false|none|If true, your User has restrictions on what can be accessed on your Account. To get details on what entities/actions you can access/perform, see [/profile/grants](/docs/api/profile/#grants-list).<br>|
|timezone|string|false|none|The timezone you prefer to see times in. This is not used by the API directly. It is provided for the benefit of clients such as the Linode Cloud Manager and other clients built on the API. All times returned by the API are in UTC.<br>|
|two_factor_auth|boolean|false|none|If true, logins from untrusted computers will require Two Factor Authentication.  See [/profile/tfa-enable](/docs/api/profile/#two-factor-secret-create) to enable Two Factor Authentication.<br>|
|uid|integer|false|read-only|Your unique ID in our system. This value will never change, and can safely be used to identify your User.<br>|
|username|string|false|read-only|Your username, used for logging in to our system.<br>|
|verified_phone_number|string(phone)|false|read-only|The phone number verified for this Profile with the **Phone Number Verify** ([POST /profile/phone-number/verify](/docs/api/profile/#phone-number-verify)) command.<br><br>`null` if this Profile has no verified phone number.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|authentication_type|password|
|authentication_type|github|
|lish_auth_method|password_keys|
|lish_auth_method|keys_only|
|lish_auth_method|disabled|

<h2 id="tocS_Promotion">Promotion</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapromotion"></a>
<a id="schema_Promotion"></a>
<a id="tocSpromotion"></a>
<a id="tocspromotion"></a>

```json
{
  "credit_monthly_cap": "10.00",
  "credit_remaining": "50.00",
  "description": "Receive up to $10 off your services every month for 6 months! Unused credits will expire once this promotion period ends.",
  "expire_dt": "2018-01-31T23:59:59",
  "image_url": "https://linode.com/10_a_month_promotion.svg",
  "service_type": "all",
  "summary": "$10 off your Linode a month!",
  "this_month_credit_remaining": "10.00"
}
```

Promotions generally
offer a set amount of credit that can be used toward your Linode
services, and the promotion expires after a specified date. As well,
a monthly cap on the promotional offer is set.

Simply put, a promotion offers a certain amount of credit every
month, until either the expiration date is passed, or until the total
promotional credit is used, whichever comes first.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|credit_monthly_cap|string|false|none|The amount available to spend per month.<br>|
|credit_remaining|string|false|none|The total amount of credit left for this promotion.<br>|
|description|string|false|none|A detailed description of this promotion.<br>|
|expire_dt|string|false|none|When this promotion's credits expire.<br>|
|image_url|string|false|none|The location of an image for this promotion.<br>|
|service_type|string|false|none|The service to which this promotion applies.<br>|
|summary|string|false|none|Short details of this promotion.<br>|
|this_month_credit_remaining|string|false|none|The amount of credit left for this month for this promotion.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|service_type|all|
|service_type|backup|
|service_type|blockstorage|
|service_type|db_mysql|
|service_type|ip_v4|
|service_type|linode|

|service_type|linode_memory|
|service_type|longview|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|rev_note|string|false|none|This field allows you to add notes for the set of revisions made to this StackScript.<br>|
|script|string|false|none|The script to execute when provisioning a new Linode with this StackScript.<br>|
|updated|string(date-time)|false|read-only|The date this StackScript was last updated.<br>|
|user_defined_fields|[[UserDefinedField](#schemauserdefinedfield)]|false|read-only|This is a list of fields defined with a special syntax inside this StackScript that allow for supplying customized parameters during deployment. See [Declare User-Defined Fields (UDFs)](/docs/products/tools/stackscripts/guides/write-a-custom-script/#declare-user-defined-fields-udfs) for more information.<br>|
|user_gravatar_id|string|false|read-only|The Gravatar ID for the User who created the StackScript.<br>|
|username|string|false|read-only|The User who created the StackScript.<br>|

|vlan|string|false|none|The label of the VLAN this ticket is regarding, if relevant. To view your VLANs, use the VLANs List ([GET /networking/vlans](/docs/api/networking/#vlans-list)) endpoint.<br><br>Requires a specified `region` to identify the VLAN.<br>|
|volume_id|integer|false|none|The ID of the Volume this ticket is regarding, if relevant.<br>|

A User on your Account. Unrestricted users can log in and access information about your Account, while restricted users may only access entities or perform actions they've been granted access to.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|restricted|boolean|false|none|If true, the User must be granted access to perform actions or access entities on this Account. See User Grants View ([GET /account/users/{username}/grants](/docs/api/account/#users-grants-view)) for details on how to configure grants for a restricted User.<br>|
|ssh_keys|[string]|false|read-only|A list of SSH Key labels added by this User.<br><br>Users can add keys with the SSH Key Add ([POST /profile/sshkeys](/docs/api/profile/#ssh-key-add)) command.<br><br>These keys are deployed when this User is included in the `authorized_users`<br>field of the following requests:<br>- Linode Create ([POST /linode/instances](/docs/api/linode-instances/#linode-create))<br>- Linode Rebuild ([POST /linode/instances/{linodeId}/rebuild](/docs/api/linode-instances/#linode-rebuild))<br>- Disk Create ([POST /linode/instances/{linodeId}/disks](/docs/api/linode-instances/#disk-create))<br>|
|tfa_enabled|boolean|false|read-only|A boolean value indicating if the User has Two Factor Authentication (TFA) enabled. See the Create Two Factor Secret ([POST /profile/tfa-enable](/docs/api/profile/#two-factor-secret-create)) endpoint to enable TFA.<br>|
|username|string|false|none|The User's username. This is used for logging in, and may also be displayed alongside actions the User performs (for example, in Events or public StackScripts).<br>|

|status|string|false|read-only|The current status of the volume.  Can be one of:<br><br>  * `creating` - the Volume is being created and is not yet available<br>    for use.<br>  * `active` - the Volume is online and available for use.<br>  * `resizing` - the Volume is in the process of upgrading<br>    its current capacity.<br>|
|tags|[string]|false|none|An array of Tags applied to this object.  Tags are for organizational purposes only.<br>|
|updated|string(date-time)|false|read-only|When this Volume was last updated.|
